properties.name: 2026-10-02: on Anthony's word, the hub address-book idea is left OPEN, and the served hub skill's wrong sentence is to be fixed now (it names the MCP config as a local hub's member list; the declared dependencies are the list)
properties.statement:
Anthony, 2026-10-02: "I accept all your recommendations."

The recommendation for this idea was to LEAVE IT OPEN. It only matters for a local hub driven through the `--call` door, and his work use is one design.

The wording fix was accepted with it. The served hub skill says a local hub's member list IS the session's MCP configuration. Measured the same day (fact:root-cause-a-local-hubs-list-is-its-watch-manifest-but-the-hub-skill-names-the-mcp-config-and-no-pin-says-where-a-store-is-2026-10-02), the list is the hub's declared dependencies, readable under the door.

It is scheduled as the last item of the 2026-10-02 triage order, with external_dependency's receipt and a collection error landing as blocked.
